author: Megumien
quote: Im finally old enough to be made aware of ratings. Playing this as a kid was more then just playing a game, it was an experience that nothing will ever be able to recreate and it hurts when I look at games today and just know we’re never getting anything like Ocarina of Time again.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Megumien
quote: I could sit here all day and talk about how it’s a shame for society that this game is the highest anticipated game of the last decade but we don’t hold grudges so let’s talk real. The only thing the game really has going for itself is the graphics, the character design was good at first, but coming from the mid story line it’s very clear that they lack a lot of depth. Everything in this game screams, mainstream, and it just shows how much games now days are focused on sells and not on extraordinary playing. Just another huge disappointment.

author: Megumien
quote: Amazing feeling, such a beautiful animation and a wonderful story. I’m amazed at how much of the original they managed to keep, all the different Easter eggs were really heartwarming.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
